描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. its body is made of pottery with green lead glaze. this is the figure of an attendant wearing a red hat, with left hand stretched out, standing on a hexagonal plinth. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 其身体是由绿色铅釉的陶器制成。 这是一个戴着红帽子的侍者的形象，左手伸出，站在一个六角形的基座上。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
